## nve-alert-group

An alert group is an element that displays a group of related and important messages in a way that attracts the user's attention without interrupting the user's task.

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/alert/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | default slot for nve-alert |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| color | `'red-cardinal' \| 'gray-slate' \| 'gray-denim' \| 'blue-indigo' \| 'blue-cobalt' \| 'blue-sky' \| 'teal-cyan' \| 'green-mint' \| 'teal-seafoam' \| 'green-grass' \| 'yellow-amber' \| 'orange-pumpkin' \| 'red-tomato' \| 'pink-magenta' \| 'purple-plum' \| 'purple-violet' \| 'purple-lavender' \| 'pink-rose' \| 'green-jade' \| 'lime-pear' \| 'yellow-nova' \| 'brand-green'` | Defines a base color from the theme color palette |
| container | `'full' \| undefined` | Determines the container bounds of the element |
| prominence | `'emphasis' \| undefined` | Determines the visual prominence or weight, emphasis applies banner style alerts |
| status | `'accent' \| 'warning' \| 'success' \| 'danger' \| undefined` | Communicates the intent and semantic meaning of an element to help users understand the outcome of their actions. - `accent` Highlights important actions or draws attention to primary interactive elements. - `warning` Indicates cautionary actions that require careful consideration before proceeding. - `success` Represents positive outcomes, confirmations, or constructive actions. - `danger` Signals destructive or irreversible actions that need extra attention and confirmation. |

### CSS Properties

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| --background | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/background) |
| --border | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/border) |
| --border-radius | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/border-radius) |
| --color | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/color) |
| --font-size | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/font-size) |
| --gap | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/gap) |
| --padding | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/padding) |

## nve-alert

Alert is an element that displays a brief, important message in a way that attracts the user's attention without interrupting the user's task.

### Example

```html
<nve-alert>alert message</nve-alert>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/alert/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | Default content placed inside of the alert. |
| actions | `string` | Actions render on the right side of the alert. Actions are typically buttons, but can also be links. Use actions for steps the user can take to resolve the alert. |
| content | `string` | Content for large overflow text. |
| icon | `string` | Icon slot renders on the left side of the alert. Icons typically represent the alert's status. |
| prefix | `string` | Prefix slot renders between the icon and the content. Prefixes typically represent the alert's status. |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| closable | `boolean` | Indicates whether the user can dismiss or close the element. - `true` The element displays a close control and the user can dismiss it. - `false` The user cannot close the element and must dismiss it programmatically. |
| i18n |  | Enables updating internal string values for internationalization. |
| status | `'accent' \| 'warning' \| 'success' \| 'danger' \| 'scheduled' \| 'queued' \| 'pending' \| 'starting' \| 'running' \| 'restarting' \| 'stopping' \| 'finished' \| 'failed' \| 'unknown' \| 'ignored' \| 'muted' \| undefined` | Defines visual treatment to represent a ongoing task or support status. - `accent` Highlights important actions or draws attention to primary interactive elements. - `warning` Indicates cautionary actions that require careful consideration before proceeding. - `success` Represents positive outcomes, confirmations, or constructive actions. - `danger` Signals destructive or irreversible actions that need extra attention and confirmation. - `scheduled` Task has a scheduled future execution at a specific time. - `queued` Task is waiting in line to begin after other tasks complete. - `pending` Task is awaiting approval, user input, or external conditions before proceeding. - `starting` Task is initializing and preparing to begin active execution. - `running` Task is actively executing and making progress. - `restarting` Task restarts after an interruption or reset. - `stopping` Task is gracefully shutting down and completing cleanup operations. - `finished` Task has completed successfully with the expected outcome. - `failed` Task encountered an error and did not complete as intended. - `unknown` Task status remains unknown or unavailable. - `ignored` Task was intentionally skipped or excluded from execution. |

### Events

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| close | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched when the alert closes within an alert group. |

### Invoker Commands

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| --close | `CommandEvent` | Use to set the alert closed/hidden state. |

### CSS Properties

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| --align-items | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/align-items) |
| --color | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/color) |
| --font-size | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/font-size) |
| --font-weight | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/font-weight) |
| --gap | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/gap) |
| --height | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/height) |
| --icon-color | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/color) |
| --icon-size | `string` |  |
| --justify-content | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/justify-content) |
| --min-height | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/min-height) |
| --text-transform | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/text-transform) |
| --width | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/width) |

## nve-badge

A visual indicator that communicates a status description of an associated component. Status badges use short text, color, built in icons for quick recognition and render near the relevant content.

### Example

```html
<nve-badge>badge</nve-badge>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/badge/define.js';
```

### Slots

## nve-button-group

A button group organizes related buttons and can support either mutually exclusive single or multi selection. Prefer usage within toolbars.

### Example

```html
<nve-button-group>
  <nve-icon-button selected icon-name="copy"></nve-icon-button>
  <nve-icon-button icon-name="add-comment"></nve-icon-button>
  <nve-icon-button icon-name="download"></nve-icon-button>
</nve-button-group>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/button-group/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | default slot for `nve-button` or `nve-icon-button` |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| behaviorSelect (behavior-select) | `'single' \| 'multi'` | By default the button group is stateless. Add the `behavior-select` attribute and set to `single` or `multi` to enable stateful selction handling. |
| container | `'flat' \| 'rounded' \| undefined` | Set the style of the button group using the `container` property. Options are the default display when omitting the attribute, `flat` or `rounded`. |
| interaction | `'emphasis' \| 'destructive'` | The Interaction type provides a way to show the intent of an interactive element. This can help users quickly understand what each interaction does and reduce the potential for confusion or errors. - `emphasis` Shows the interaction targets emphasis or highlighting primary actions. - `destructive` Shows the interaction targets destructive actions such as deleting or removing. |
| orientation | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical' \| undefined` | Controls the directional flow of the element's layout and interaction pattern. - `horizontal` Element orients horizontally with left-to-right flow. - `vertical` Element orients vertically with top-to-bottom flow. |
| size | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| undefined` | Controls the visual scale of an element to match its importance and available space. - `sm` Compact size for dense layouts or secondary elements with less visual prominence. - `md` Standard size that works well in most contexts and provides balanced visibility. - `lg` Larger size for emphasizing important elements or improving touch targets in spacious layouts. |

### CSS Properties

## nve-button

A button is a widget that enables users to trigger an action or event, such as submitting a form, opening a dialog, canceling an action, or performing a delete operation.

### Example

```html
<nve-button>standard</nve-button>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/button/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | slot for button text content or icon, icon placement depends on whether `icon` appears before or after text content. |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| command | `string` | The command to execute on the element. https://mdn.dev/Invoker_Commands_API |
| commandForElement (commandfor) | property: `HTMLElement \| null`; attribute: `string` | The element that receives the command. https://mdn.dev/Invoker_Commands_API |
| container | `'flat' \| 'inline' \| undefined` | Determines the container of the button. Flat suits nesting within other containers or more muted style. Inline suits inline content such as text. |
| current | `'page' \| 'step'` | Indicates the element that represents the user's current location or position within a set. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-current) - `page` Marks the current page within a set of navigation links. - `step` Marks the current step within a multi-step process or workflow. |
| disabled | `boolean` | This Boolean attribute prevents the user from interacting with the element: it cannot receive press or focus events. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-disabled) - `true` The element has a disabled state and does not accept interaction. - `false` The element has an enabled state and accepts interaction. |
| expanded | `boolean` | Indicates whether collapsible content is currently visible or hidden from the user. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-expanded) - `true` The associated content expands and becomes visible to the user. - `false` The associated content collapses and hides from the user. |
| form | property: `string \| HTMLFormElement \| null`; attribute: `string` | Associates the button with a form. Set the property to a form element or its ID. The HTML attribute accepts only the form ID. Reading the property returns the associated form element or `null`. https://mdn.dev/ElementInternals/form |
| interaction | `'emphasis' \| 'destructive'` | The Interaction type provides a way to show the intent of an interactive element. This can help users quickly understand what each interaction does and reduce the potential for confusion or errors. - `emphasis` Shows the interaction targets emphasis or highlighting primary actions. - `destructive` Shows the interaction targets destructive actions such as deleting or removing. |
| interestForElement (interestfor) | property: `HTMLElement \| null`; attribute: `string` | The element that receives the interest. https://mdn.dev/HTMLAnchorElement/interestForElement |
| name | `string` | The name of the button, submitted as a pair with the button value as part of the form data. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Element/button#attr-name |
| popoverTargetAction (popovertargetaction) | `'show' \| 'hide' \| 'toggle'` | The popover target action to perform on the popover target element. https://mdn.dev/HTMLInputElement/popoverTargetAction |
| popoverTargetElement (popovertarget) | property: `HTMLElement \| null`; attribute: `string` | Establishes a relationship between a popover and its invoker button. https://mdn.dev/HTMLInputElement/popoverTargetElement |
| pressed | `boolean` | Indicates the current state of a toggle button that switches on or off. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-pressed) - `true` The button is in the pressed (on) state and the associated action or setting is active. - `false` The button is in the unpressed (off) state and the associated action or setting is inactive. |
| readOnly (readonly) | `boolean` | Indicates whether the element is a noninteractive visual treatment instead of a button. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/readonly |
| selected | `boolean` | Indicates whether an element currently holds selection within a multi-option selection group. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-selected) - `true` The element holds selection and represents the user's current choice within the group. - `false` The element does not hold selection and the user can choose it. |
| size | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| undefined` | Controls the visual scale of an element to match its importance and available space. - `sm` Compact size for dense layouts or secondary elements with less visual prominence. - `md` Standard size that works well in most contexts and provides balanced visibility. - `lg` Larger size for emphasizing important elements or improving touch targets in spacious layouts. |
| type | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | Defines the button behavior when associated within a form element. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Element/button#attr-type |
| value | `string` | Defines the value associated with the element's name when submitting the form data. The server receives this value in params when the form submits through this button. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/HTML/Element/input#value) |

### CSS Properties

## nve-checkbox

A checkbox is a control that enables users to choose between two distinct mutually exclusive options (checked or unchecked, on or off) through a single click or tap.

### Example

```html
<nve-checkbox>
  <label>label</label>
  <input type="checkbox" checked />
</nve-checkbox>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/checkbox/define.js';
```

## nve-color

A color picker is a control that enables users to choose a color value.

### Example

```html
<nve-color>
  <label>label</label>
  <input type="color" />
  <nve-control-message>message</nve-control-message>
</nve-color>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/color/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | Control input element |
| label | `string` | Label element |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| container | `'flat' \| undefined` | Reduces the visual container for a minimal borderless appearance while preserving whitespace bounds. Use when embedding within another container such as a toolbar. |

| fitText (fit-text) | `boolean` | Sets the input to match the width of the active text content of the control value. Only applicable to vertical input box type controls (input, select) |
| i18n |  | Enables internal string values to update for internationalization. |

    \| 'vertical-inline'
    \| 'horizontal'
    \| 'horizontal-inline'` | Controls the directional arrangement and spacing behavior of the element's content. - `vertical` Arranges content in a vertical stack with block-level spacing. - `vertical-inline` Arranges content vertically with compact inline spacing for dense layouts. - `horizontal` Arranges content in a horizontal row with block-level spacing. - `horizontal-inline` Arranges content horizontally with compact inline spacing. |
| prominence | `'muted'` | Set the visual prominence of the control |
| status | `'warning' \| 'error' \| 'success' \| 'disabled'` | Set current visual state for control. This overrides any validation states active. |

## nve-combobox

An editable combobox with autocomplete behavior and selection support.

### Example

```html
<nve-combobox>
  <label>label</label>
  <input type="search" />
  <datalist>
    <option value="status"></option>
    <option value="priority"></option>
    <option value="date"></option>
    <option value="session"></option>
    <option value="configuration"></option>
    <option value="contains"></option>
  </datalist>
  <nve-control-message>message</nve-control-message>
</nve-combobox>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/combobox/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | default slot for an input and a datalist/select element |
| footer | `string` | slot for dropdown footer content |
| label | `string` | Label element |
| prefix-icon | `string` | slot for icon before the input |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| behaviorCreate (behavior-create) | `boolean` | Enable creation of new options when the input value doesn't match any existing option. Dispatches a `create` event with `{ value }` detail. |
| container | `'flat'` | Reduces the visual container for a minimal borderless appearance while preserving whitespace bounds. Use when embedding within another container such as a toolbar. |
| fitContent (fit-content) | `boolean` | Sets the input to match native default content block |
| fitText (fit-text) | `boolean` | Sets the input to match the width of the active text content of the control value. Only applicable to vertical input box type controls (input, select) |
| i18n |  | Enables internal string values to update for internationalization. |
| layout | `\| 'vertical'
    \| 'vertical-inline'
    \| 'horizontal'
    \| 'horizontal-inline'` | Controls the directional arrangement and spacing behavior of the element's content. - `vertical` Arranges content in a vertical stack with block-level spacing. - `vertical-inline` Arranges content vertically with compact inline spacing for dense layouts. - `horizontal` Arranges content in a horizontal row with block-level spacing. - `horizontal-inline` Arranges content horizontally with compact inline spacing. |
| prominence | `'muted'` | Set the visual prominence of the control |
| status | `'warning' \| 'error' \| 'success' \| 'disabled'` | Set current visual state for control. This overrides any validation states active. |
| tagLayout (tag-layout) | `'hidden' \| 'wrap'` | Manage inline tag rendering for many-item select |

### Events

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| create | `CustomEvent` | Fires when the user confirms a value that doesn't match any existing option and the `behavior-create` attribute exists. `detail: { value }`. |
| reset | `CustomEvent` |  |
| scroll | `CustomEvent` | Fires when the user scrolls the dropdown option list. Throttled to one dispatch per animation frame. `detail: { scrollTop, scrollHeight, clientHeight }`. |

### Methods

| method | signatures | description |
| ------ | ---------- | ----------- |
| reset | `reset(): unknown` | Resets control value to initial attribute value and clears any active validation rules. |
| selectAll | `selectAll(): unknown` | Select all options provided |

### CSS Properties

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |

| --border-color | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/border-color) |

| --control-width | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/width) |
| --cursor | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/cursor) |
| --font-size | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/font-size) |
| --font-weight | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/font-weight) |

## nve-copy-button

A copy button is a button that easily enables the copy to clipboard pattern.

### Example

```html
<nve-copy-button value="hello" aria-label="copy value" behavior-copy></nve-copy-button>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/copy-button/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |

## nve-date

A date picker is a control that enables users to choose a date value.

### Example

```html
<nve-date>
  <label>date</label>
  <input type="date" />
  <nve-control-message>message</nve-control-message>
</nve-date>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/date/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | Control input element |
| label | `string` | Label element |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| container | `'flat' \| undefined` | Reduces the visual container for a minimal borderless appearance while preserving whitespace bounds. Use when embedding within another container such as a toolbar. |
| fitContent (fit-content) | `boolean` | Sets the input to match native default content block |
| fitText (fit-text) | `boolean` | Sets the input to match the width of the active text content of the control value. Only applicable to vertical input box type controls (input, select) |
| i18n |  | Enables internal string values to update for internationalization. |
| layout | `\| 'vertical'
    \| 'vertical-inline'
    \| 'horizontal'
    \| 'horizontal-inline'` | Controls the directional arrangement and spacing behavior of the element's content. - `vertical` Arranges content in a vertical stack with block-level spacing. - `vertical-inline` Arranges content vertically with compact inline spacing for dense layouts. - `horizontal` Arranges content in a horizontal row with block-level spacing. - `horizontal-inline` Arranges content horizontally with compact inline spacing. |
| prominence | `'muted'` | Set the visual prominence of the control |
| status | `'warning' \| 'error' \| 'success' \| 'disabled'` | Set current visual state for control. This overrides any validation states active. |

### Events

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| reset | `CustomEvent` |  |

## nve-drag-handle

A draggable grip button with a native drag preview. Activation toggles the pressed state; the application controls movement.

### Example

```html
<nve-drag-handle aria-label="move item"></nve-drag-handle>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/drag-handle/define.js';
```

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| command | `string` | The command to execute on the element. https://mdn.dev/Invoker_Commands_API |
| commandForElement (commandfor) | property: `HTMLElement \| null`; attribute: `string` | The element that receives the command. https://mdn.dev/Invoker_Commands_API |
| current | `'page' \| 'step'` | Indicates the element that represents the user's current location or position within a set. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-current) - `page` Marks the current page within a set of navigation links. - `step` Marks the current step within a multi-step process or workflow. |
| disabled | `boolean` | This Boolean attribute prevents the user from interacting with the element: it cannot receive press or focus events. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-disabled) - `true` The element has a disabled state and does not accept interaction. - `false` The element has an enabled state and accepts interaction. |
| expanded | `boolean` | Indicates whether collapsible content is currently visible or hidden from the user. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-expanded) - `true` The associated content expands and becomes visible to the user. - `false` The associated content collapses and hides from the user. |
| form | property: `string \| HTMLFormElement \| null`; attribute: `string` | Associates the button with a form. Set the property to a form element or its ID. The HTML attribute accepts only the form ID. Reading the property returns the associated form element or `null`. https://mdn.dev/ElementInternals/form |
| interestForElement (interestfor) | property: `HTMLElement \| null`; attribute: `string` | The element that receives the interest. https://mdn.dev/HTMLAnchorElement/interestForElement |
| name | `string` | The name of the button, submitted as a pair with the button value as part of the form data. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Element/button#attr-name |
| popoverTargetAction (popovertargetaction) | `'show' \| 'hide' \| 'toggle'` | The popover target action to perform on the popover target element. https://mdn.dev/HTMLInputElement/popoverTargetAction |
| popoverTargetElement (popovertarget) | property: `HTMLElement \| null`; attribute: `string` | Establishes a relationship between a popover and its invoker button. https://mdn.dev/HTMLInputElement/popoverTargetElement |
| pressed | `boolean` | Indicates the current state of a toggle button that switches on or off. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-pressed) - `true` The button is in the pressed (on) state and the associated action or setting is active. - `false` The button is in the unpressed (off) state and the associated action or setting is inactive. |
| readOnly (readonly) | `boolean` | Indicates whether the element is a noninteractive visual treatment instead of a button. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/readonly |
| selected | `boolean` | Indicates whether an element currently holds selection within a multi-option selection group. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-selected) - `true` The element holds selection and represents the user's current choice within the group. - `false` The element does not hold selection and the user can choose it. |
| type | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | Defines the button behavior when associated within a form element. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Element/button#attr-type |
| value | `string` | Defines the value associated with the element's name when submitting the form data. The server receives this value in params when the form submits through this button. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/HTML/Element/input#value) |

### CSS Properties

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| --border-radius | `string` | The handle corner radius. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/border-radius) |
| --color | `string` | The grip color. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/color) |
| --cursor | `string` | The cursor over the handle. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/cursor) |
| --height | `string` | The vertical size of the pointer target. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/height) |
| --width | `string` | The horizontal size of the pointer target. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/width) |

## nve-dropdown-group

A Dropdown Group streamlines the management of linked dropdowns and supports nested dropdowns for a more organized and intuitive user experience

### Example

```html
<nve-button popovertarget="menu-1">menu</nve-button>
<nve-dropdown-group>
  <nve-dropdown id="menu-1">
    <nve-menu>
      <nve-menu-item popovertarget="menu-2"> item 1-1 <nve-icon name="caret" direction="right" size="sm" slot="suffix"></nve-icon> </nve-menu-item>
      <nve-menu-item>item 1-2</nve-menu-item>
      <nve-menu-item>item 1-3</nve-menu-item>
    </nve-menu>
  </nve-dropdown>
  <nve-dropdown id="menu-2" position="right">
    <nve-menu>
      <nve-menu-item>item 2-1</nve-menu-item>
      <nve-menu-item popovertarget="menu-3"> item 2-2 <nve-icon name="caret" direction="right" size="sm" slot="suffix"></nve-icon> </nve-menu-item>
      <nve-menu-item>item 2-3</nve-menu-item>
    </nve-menu>
  </nve-dropdown>
  <nve-dropdown id="menu-3" position="right">
    <nve-menu>
      <nve-menu-item>item 3-1</nve-menu-item>
      <nve-menu-item>item 3-2</nve-menu-item>
      <nve-menu-item>item 3-3</nve-menu-item>
    </nve-menu>
  </nve-dropdown>
</nve-dropdown-group>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/dropdown-group/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | default slot for dropdown content |

### Events

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| close | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched when a dropdown in the group closes |
| open | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched when a dropdown in the group opens |

### Methods

| method | signatures | description |
| ------ | ---------- | ----------- |
| close | `close(): unknown` | Closes every descendant dropdown in the group. |

### CSS Properties

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| --arrow-transform | `string` | Transform applied to the popover arrow |

## nve-dropdown

Generic dropdown element for rendering a variety of different content such as interactive navigation or form controls.

### Example

```html
<nve-button popovertarget="dropdown">button</nve-button>
<nve-dropdown id="dropdown">dropdown content</nve-dropdown>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/dropdown/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | default slot for dropdown content |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| alignment | `'start' \| 'end' \| 'center'` | Determines the alignment of the popover relative to the provided anchor element. - `start` Aligns the popover to the beginning edge of the anchor for left or top alignment. - `end` Aligns the popover to the ending edge of the anchor for right or bottom alignment. - `center` Centers the popover along the anchor's edge for balanced positioning. |
| anchor | property: `string \| HTMLElement`; attribute: `string` | Provides the element that the popover should position relative to. Set the property to an element or its ID within the same render root. The HTML attribute accepts only the element ID. |
| arrow | `boolean` | Determines if an arrow renders. |
| closable | `boolean` | Indicates whether the user can dismiss or close the element. - `true` The element displays a close control and the user can dismiss it. - `false` The user cannot close the element and must dismiss it programmatically. |
| i18n |  | Enables internal string values to update for internationalization. |
| position | `'center' \| 'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'left' \| 'right'` | Sets the side position of the popover relative to the provided anchor element. - `center` Centers the popover directly over the anchor element. - `top` Positions the popover above the anchor element. - `bottom` Positions the popover below the anchor element. - `left` Positions the popover to the left side of the anchor element. - `right` Positions the popover to the right side of the anchor element. |

### Events

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| beforetoggle | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched on a popover just before showing or hiding. |
| close | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched when the dropdown closes. |
| open | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched when the dropdown opens. |
| toggle | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched on a popover element just after showing or hiding. |

### CSS Properties

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| --animation-duration | `string` | Duration of dropdown open/close animations [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/animation-duration) |

## nve-dropzone

A dropzone form control that enables users to drag and drop files onto it.

### Example

```html
<nve-dropzone name="files" style="--min-height: 200px"></nve-dropzone>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/dropzone/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | Custom messaging that replaces the default upload instructions. |
| icon | `string` | Custom icon that replaces the default upload icon. |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| accept | `string` | Comma-separated file extensions or MIME types accepted by the dropzone. |

| defaultValue | `string` | The initial value used when the parent form resets. |
| disabled | `boolean` | This Boolean attribute prevents the user from interacting with the element: it cannot receive press or focus events. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-disabled) - `true` The element has a disabled state and does not accept interaction. - `false` The element has an enabled state and accepts interaction. |
| form | `HTMLFormElement \| null` | The form associated with the control. https://mdn.dev/ElementInternals/form |

| min | `number \| null` | Defines the minimum numeric value. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/min |
| minLength (minlength) | `number` | Defines the minimum text length. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/minlength |
| name | `string` | The name submitted with the control value as part of the form data. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/name |
| noValidate (novalidate) | `boolean` | Disables constraint validation for this control. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/novalidate |
| pattern | `string` | Defines the pattern that text values must match. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/pattern |
| readOnly (readonly) | `boolean` | Indicates whether the user can change the element's value while it remains visible and focusable. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/readonly) - `true` The element has a readonly state: the user cannot change its value, but can still focus and copy it. - `false` The element allows editing and the user can change its value through interaction. |

## nve-format-datetime

Formats a date/time value as localized text using the Intl.DateTimeFormat API. Renders inside a semantic time element.
Granular options (weekday, year, month, day, hour, minute, second) mirror the Intl.DateTimeFormat API. 'numeric' omits zero-padding, '2-digit' zero-pads.

### Example

```html
<nve-format-datetime date-style="long">2023-07-28T04:20:17.434Z</nve-format-datetime>
```

## nve-control

Wraps a form input with its associated label and validation messages, managing layout and accessibility associations.

### Example

```html
<nve-control>
  <label>label</label>
  <input />
  <nve-control-message>message</nve-control-message>
</nve-control>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/forms/define.js';
```

### Slots

| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | Control input element |
| label | `string` | Label element |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| fitContent (fit-content) | `boolean` | Sets the input to match native default content block |
| fitText (fit-text) | `boolean` | Sets the input to match the width of the active text content of the control value. Only applicable to vertical input box type controls (input, select) |
| i18n |  | Enables internal string values to update for internationalization. |
| layout | `\| 'vertical'
    \| 'vertical-inline'
    \| 'horizontal'
    \| 'horizontal-inline'` | Controls the directional arrangement and spacing behavior of the element's content. - `vertical` Arranges content in a vertical stack with block-level spacing. - `vertical-inline` Arranges content vertically with compact inline spacing for dense layouts. - `horizontal` Arranges content in a horizontal row with block-level spacing. - `horizontal-inline` Arranges content horizontally with compact inline spacing. |
| prominence | `'muted'` | Set the visual prominence of the control |
| status | `'warning' \| 'error' \| 'success' \| 'disabled'` | Set current visual state for control. This overrides any validation states active. |

| ---- | ----- | ----------- |

## nve-gauge

Use a gauge to show system resource usage.

### Example

```html
<nve-gauge status="accent" value="66">66%</nve-gauge>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/gauge/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | Content to display in the gauge center. |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| i18n |  | Enables updating internal string values for internationalization. |
| max | `number` | The `max` value of the gauge that the `value` is proportionally scaled to. |
| shape | `'half' \| undefined` | Determines the gauge shape. Set `half` for a compact semi-circular arc. |
| size | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| undefined` | Controls the visual scale of an element to match its importance and available space. - `sm` Compact size for dense layouts or secondary elements with less visual prominence. - `md` Standard size that works well in most contexts and provides balanced visibility. - `lg` Larger size for emphasizing important elements or improving touch targets in spacious layouts. |
| status | `'accent' \| 'warning' \| 'success' \| 'danger' \| 'neutral' \| undefined` | Four visual treatments represent the `status` of tasks. - `accent` Highlights important actions or draws attention to primary interactive elements. - `warning` Indicates cautionary actions that require careful consideration before proceeding. - `success` Represents positive outcomes, confirmations, or constructive actions. - `danger` Signals destructive or irreversible actions that need extra attention and confirmation. |
| thumb | `'fill' \| 'dot' \| 'needle'` | Controls the value indicator. Set `dot` for only the end dot or `needle` for a pointer. |
| value | `number` | The current `value` of the gauge. |

### CSS Properties

| --font-size | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/font-size) |

| --track-background | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/background) |

## nve-grid-column

Defines a column header within a grid, specifying the column's label, width, and alignment for all cells beneath it.

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/grid/define.js';
```

| name | value | description |

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |

| position | `'fixed' \| 'sticky' \| ''` | Set the `position` property or attribute to `fixed` or `sticky` to make the column fixed or sticky. Fixed columns do not scroll horizontally with the grid. Sticky columns scroll horizontally with the grid until the column reaches the edge of the grid. |
| width | `string` | Only set a fixed px width when you know the grid width. Most cases this should remain unset. If the total width of all columns is less than the grid width then the last column fills the remaining space. By default column widths are evenly divided unless width is explicitly provided. |

## nve-iframe

An iframe component that syncs with the parent document's theme and template content. Use when needing to render dynamically generated or isolated content.

### Example

```html
<nve-iframe aria-label="Elements iframe example">
  <template slot="head">
    <title>Elements iframe example</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@nvidia-elements/themes/dist/bundles/index.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@nvidia-elements/themes/dist/fonts/inter.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@nvidia-elements/styles/dist/bundles/index.css" />
    <script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@nvidia-elements/core/dist/bundles/index.min.js"></script>
  </template>
  <template>
    <nve-alert status="success">isolated iframe content</nve-alert>
  </template>
</nve-iframe>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/iframe/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | A template containing the iframe body content. |
| head | `string` | A template containing content inserted into the iframe head. |

### CSS Properties

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| --border | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/border) |
| --height | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/height) |
| --width | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/width) |

## nve-input-group

Visually combines many related input controls into a unified composite field with shared styling.

### Example

```html
<nve-input-group>
  <label>domain</label>
  <nve-select style="width: 130px">
    <select aria-label="protocol">
      <option>https://</option>
      <option>http://</option>
    </select>
  </nve-select>
  <nve-input>
    <input placeholder="example" type="url" aria-label="host" />
    <nve-button container="flat" readonly="">.com</nve-button>
  </nve-input>
  <nve-control-message>host: 123456</nve-control-message>
</nve-input-group>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/input/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | Control input elements |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| inputs |  | Returns the input elements associated with the control group. |
| label |  | Returns the label associated with the control group. |
| layout | `\| 'vertical'
    \| 'vertical-inline'
    \| 'horizontal'
    \| 'horizontal-inline'` | Controls the directional arrangement and spacing behavior of the element's content. - `vertical` Arranges content in a vertical stack with block-level spacing. - `vertical-inline` Arranges content vertically with compact inline spacing for dense layouts. - `horizontal` Arranges content in a horizontal row with block-level spacing. - `horizontal-inline` Arranges content horizontally with compact inline spacing. |
| prominence | `'muted'` | Set the visual prominence of the control group |

### CSS Properties

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| --background | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/background) |
| --border | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/border) |
| --border-radius | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/border-radius) |
| --color | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/color) |
| --gap | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/gap) |
| --label-color | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/color) |
| --label-font-size | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/font-size) |
| --label-font-weight | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/font-weight) |
| --label-text-transform | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/text-transform) |
| --padding | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/padding) |

## nve-input

An input is a control that enables users to enter text.

### Example

```html
<nve-input>
  <label>label</label>
  <input type="text" />
  <nve-control-message>message</nve-control-message>
</nve-input>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/input/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | Control input element |
| label | `string` | Label element |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| container | `'flat' \| undefined` | Reduces the visual container for a minimal borderless appearance while preserving whitespace bounds. Use when embedding within another container such as a toolbar. |
| fitContent (fit-content) | `boolean` | Sets the input to match native default content block |
| fitText (fit-text) | `boolean` | Sets the input to match the width of the active text content of the control value. Only applicable to vertical input box type controls (input, select) |
| i18n |  | Enables internal string values to update for internationalization. |
| layout | `\| 'vertical'
    \| 'vertical-inline'
    \| 'horizontal'
    \| 'horizontal-inline'` | Controls the directional arrangement and spacing behavior of the element's content. - `vertical` Arranges content in a vertical stack with block-level spacing. - `vertical-inline` Arranges content vertically with compact inline spacing for dense layouts. - `horizontal` Arranges content in a horizontal row with block-level spacing. - `horizontal-inline` Arranges content horizontally with compact inline spacing. |
| prominence | `'muted'` | Set the visual prominence of the control |
| rounded | `boolean` | Sets the rounded visual style of the input. |
| status | `'warning' \| 'error' \| 'success' \| 'disabled'` | Set current visual state for control. This overrides any validation states active. |

### Events

## nve-menu

A menu offers a list of choices to the user, such as a set of actions or functions. Choosing an item in a menu typically opens a sub menu, or invokes a command.

### Example

```html
<nve-menu>
  <nve-menu-item>item 1</nve-menu-item>
  <nve-menu-item>item 2</nve-menu-item>
  <nve-menu-item>item 3</nve-menu-item>
  <nve-menu-item>item 4</nve-menu-item>
</nve-menu>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/menu/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | default slot for `nve-menu-item` |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| density | `'compact' \| 'default' \| undefined` | Determines if the menu is in a compact layout. This hides all menu item content except the prefix icon slot. - `compact` Reduces visual weight and spacing for dense layouts or secondary elements with less visual prominence. - `default` Standard size that works well in most contexts and provides balanced visibility. |

### Events

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| scroll | `CustomEvent` | Fires when the user scrolls the menu list. Throttled to one dispatch per animation frame. `detail: { scrollTop, scrollHeight, clientHeight }`. |

### CSS Properties

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| --gap | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/gap) |
| --max-height | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/max-height) |
| --max-width | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/max-width) |
| --min-width | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/min-width) |
| --padding | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/padding) |

## nve-month

A month picker is a control that enables users to choose a month value.

### Example

```html
<nve-month>
  <label>label</label>
  <input type="month" />
  <nve-control-message>message</nve-control-message>
</nve-month>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/month/define.js';
```

| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | Control input element |
| label | `string` | Label element |

### Properties / Attributes

| container | `'flat' \| undefined` | Reduces the visual container for a minimal borderless appearance while preserving whitespace bounds. Use when embedding within another container such as a toolbar. |

| i18n |  | Enables internal string values to update for internationalization. |

    \| 'vertical-inline'
    \| 'horizontal'
    \| 'horizontal-inline'` | Controls the directional arrangement and spacing behavior of the element's content. - `vertical` Arranges content in a vertical stack with block-level spacing. - `vertical-inline` Arranges content vertically with compact inline spacing for dense layouts. - `horizontal` Arranges content in a horizontal row with block-level spacing. - `horizontal-inline` Arranges content horizontally with compact inline spacing. |
| prominence | `'muted'` | Set the visual prominence of the control |
| status | `'warning' \| 'error' \| 'success' \| 'disabled'` | Set current visual state for control. This overrides any validation states active. |

Child panel for embedded panels within the page component. Typically used for left/right/bottom page slot positions.

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/page/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | `nve-page-panel-content` elements that provide the panel body. |
| actions | `string` | slot for action / dismiss buttons |

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| i18n |  | Enables updating internal string values for internationalization. |
| size | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| undefined` | Controls the visual scale of an element to match its importance and available space. - `sm` Compact size for dense layouts or secondary elements with less visual prominence. - `md` Standard size that works well in most contexts and provides balanced visibility. - `lg` Larger size for emphasizing important elements or improving touch targets in spacious layouts. |

### Events

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| close | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched after an invoker command sets `hidden` and closes the panel. |
| open | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched after an invoker command removes `hidden` and opens the panel. |

### Invoker Commands

| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| --close | `CommandEvent` | Sets `hidden` and dispatches `close`. |
| --open | `CommandEvent` | Removes `hidden` and dispatches `open`. |

## nve-pagination

Pagination is a control that enables users to navigate through pages of content.

### Example

```html
<nve-pagination value="1" items="100" step="10"></nve-pagination>
<script type="module">
  const pagination = document.querySelector("nve-pagination");
  pagination.addEventListener("change", (e) => console.log(e.target.value));
</script>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/pagination/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| suffix-label | `string` | Overrides the "of total" label when the total is an approximation. |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| composedLabel | `string` | Text content from labels associated with the control. |
| container | `'flat' \| 'inline' \| undefined` | Determines the container styles of component. Flat applies when nesting within other containers. Inline applies when placing within other inline content. |
| defaultValue | `string` | The initial value used when the parent form resets. |
| disabled | `boolean` | This Boolean attribute prevents the user from interacting with the element: it cannot receive press or focus events. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-disabled) - `true` The element has a disabled state and does not accept interaction. - `false` The element has an enabled state and accepts interaction. |
| disableStep (disable-step) | `boolean` | Whether the step selector has a disabled state. |
| form | `HTMLFormElement \| null` | The form associated with the control. https://mdn.dev/ElementInternals/form |
| i18n |  | Enables updating internal string values for internationalization. |
| items | `number` | The total number of items. |
| labels | `NodeList` | Labels associated with the control. https://mdn.dev/ElementInternals/labels |
| max | `number \| null` | Defines the maximum numeric value. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/max |
| maxLength (maxlength) | `number` | Defines the maximum text length. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/maxlength |
| min | `number \| null` | Defines the minimum numeric value. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/min |
| minLength (minlength) | `number` | Defines the minimum text length. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/minlength |
| name | `string` | The name submitted with the control value as part of the form data. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/name |
| noValidate (novalidate) | `boolean` | Disables constraint validation for this control. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/novalidate |
| pattern | `string` | Defines the pattern that text values must match. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/pattern |
| readOnly (readonly) | `boolean` | Indicates whether the user can change the element's value while it remains visible and focusable. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/readonly) - `true` The element has a readonly state: the user cannot change its value, but can still focus and copy it. - `false` The element allows editing and the user can change its value through interaction. |
| required | `boolean` | Requires a value before the parent form can submit. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/required |
| skippable | `boolean` | Whether the pagination is skippable to start/end. |
| step | `number` | The number of items per page. |
| stepSizes (step-sizes) | property: `number[]`; attribute: `string` | Page-size options available in the selector. |
| type | `string` | The control type. |
| validationMessage | `string` | The validation message shown when the control is invalid. https://mdn.dev/ElementInternals/validationMessage |
| validity | `ValidityState` | The control validity state. https://mdn.dev/ElementInternals/validity |
| value | `number` | value the current page number |
| valueAsNumber | `number` | The current value parsed as a number. |
| valueAsString | `string` | The current value serialized as a string. |
| willValidate | `boolean` | Indicates whether the control participates in constraint validation. https://mdn.dev/ElementInternals/willValidate |

### Events

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| change | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched when the value (page) has changed |
| first-page | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched when the first page is active |
| input | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched when the value (page) has changed |
| last-page | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched when the last page is active |
| step-change | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched after the page size changes with the current page size in `detail`. The event bubbles and crosses shadow boundaries. |

### Methods

| method | signatures | description |
| ------ | ---------- | ----------- |
| checkValidity | `checkValidity(): boolean` | Checks whether the control satisfies its constraints. https://mdn.dev/HTMLInputElement/checkValidity |
| reportValidity | `reportValidity(): boolean` | Reports whether the control satisfies its constraints. https://mdn.dev/HTMLInputElement/reportValidity |
| reset | `reset(): void` | Resets the control value to its initial value. |
| setCustomValidity | `setCustomValidity(message: string): void` | Sets a custom validation message. https://mdn.dev/HTMLInputElement/setCustomValidity |

### CSS Properties

| --background | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/background) |

| --width | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/width) |

## nve-password

A password is a control that enables users to enter password text.

### Example

```html
<nve-password>
  <label>label</label>
  <input type="password" value="123456" />
  <nve-control-message>message</nve-control-message>
</nve-password>
```

## nve-progress-bar

A progress bar is a visual indicator of the status of a running task. Under the hood, the component uses the native HTML `progress` element to achieve proper a11y concerns.

### Example

```html
<nve-progress-bar value="50"></nve-progress-bar>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/progress-bar/define.js';
```

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| max | `number` | The `max` property sets the highest value that `value` scales to. |
| status | `'accent' \| 'warning' \| 'success' \| 'danger'` | Communicates the intent and semantic meaning of an element to help users understand the outcome of their actions. - `accent` Highlights important actions or draws attention to primary interactive elements. - `warning` Indicates cautionary actions that require careful consideration before proceeding. - `success` Represents positive outcomes, confirmations, or constructive actions. - `danger` Signals destructive or irreversible actions that need extra attention and confirmation. |
| value | `number \| undefined` | The current `value` of the progress indicator, set to the native HTML progress element. |

### CSS Properties

| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| --accent-color | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/accent-color) |

| --height | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/height) |
| --indeterminate-gradient | `string` | Gradient used for indeterminate state animation |

## nve-progressive-filter-chip

A filter chip is a control that enables users to select many options from a set of choices.

### Example

```html
<nve-progressive-filter-chip closable>
  <nve-select>
    <select aria-label="dataset">
      <option>workload</option>
      <option selected>instance</option>
    </select>
  </nve-select>
  <nve-select>
    <select aria-label="condition">
      <option>sort by</option>
      <option selected>filter by</option>
    </select>
  </nve-select>
  <nve-select>
```

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/progressive-filter-chip/define.js';
```

## nve-resize-handle

```html
<nve-resize-handle></nve-resize-handle>
```

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/resize-handle/define.js';
```

| disabled | `boolean` | This Boolean attribute prevents the user from interacting with the element: it cannot receive press or focus events. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-disabled) - `true` The element has a disabled state and does not accept interaction. - `false` The element has an enabled state and accepts interaction. |

| i18n |  | Updates internal string values for internationalization. |
| labels | `NodeList` | Labels associated with the control. https://mdn.dev/ElementInternals/labels |
| max | `number` | Determines the max resize value. |
| maxLength (maxlength) | `number` | Defines the maximum text length. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/maxlength |
| min | `number` | Determines the min resize value. |
| minLength (minlength) | `number` | Defines the minimum text length. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/minlength |
| name | `string` | The name submitted with the control value as part of the form data. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/name |
| noValidate (novalidate) | `boolean` | Disables constraint validation for this control. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/novalidate |
| orientation | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical' \| undefined` | Controls the directional flow of the element's layout and interaction pattern. - `horizontal` Element orients horizontally with left-to-right flow. - `vertical` Element orients vertically with top-to-bottom flow. |
| pattern | `string` | Defines the pattern that text values must match. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/pattern |

[MDN](https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/readonly) - `true` The element has a readonly state: the user cannot change its value, but can still focus and copy it. - `false` The element allows editing and the user can change its value through interaction. |

## nve-sort-button

A sort button is a control that enables users to sort a list of items in ascending or descending order.

### Example

```html
<nve-sort-button></nve-sort-button>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/sort-button/define.js';
```

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| command | `string` | The command to execute on the element. https://mdn.dev/Invoker_Commands_API |
| commandForElement (commandfor) | property: `HTMLElement \| null`; attribute: `string` | The element that receives the command. https://mdn.dev/Invoker_Commands_API |
| current | `'page' \| 'step'` | Indicates the element that represents the user's current location or position within a set. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-current) - `page` Marks the current page within a set of navigation links. - `step` Marks the current step within a multi-step process or workflow. |
| disabled | `boolean` | This Boolean attribute prevents the user from interacting with the element: it cannot receive press or focus events. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-disabled) - `true` The element has a disabled state and does not accept interaction. - `false` The element has an enabled state and accepts interaction. |
| expanded | `boolean` | Indicates whether collapsible content is currently visible or hidden from the user. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-expanded) - `true` The associated content expands and becomes visible to the user. - `false` The associated content collapses and hides from the user. |
| form | property: `string \| HTMLFormElement \| null`; attribute: `string` | Associates the button with a form. Set the property to a form element or its ID. The HTML attribute accepts only the form ID. Reading the property returns the associated form element or `null`. https://mdn.dev/ElementInternals/form |
| i18n |  | Updates internal string values for internationalization. |
| interestForElement (interestfor) | property: `HTMLElement \| null`; attribute: `string` | The element that receives the interest. https://mdn.dev/HTMLAnchorElement/interestForElement |
| name | `string` | The name of the button, submitted as a pair with the button value as part of the form data. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Element/button#attr-name |
| popoverTargetAction (popovertargetaction) | `'show' \| 'hide' \| 'toggle'` | The popover target action to perform on the popover target element. https://mdn.dev/HTMLInputElement/popoverTargetAction |
| popoverTargetElement (popovertarget) | property: `HTMLElement \| null`; attribute: `string` | Establishes a relationship between a popover and its invoker button. https://mdn.dev/HTMLInputElement/popoverTargetElement |
| pressed | `boolean` | Indicates the current state of a toggle button that switches on or off. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-pressed) - `true` The button is in the pressed (on) state and the associated action or setting is active. - `false` The button is in the unpressed (off) state and the associated action or setting is inactive. |
| readOnly (readonly) | `boolean` | Indicates whether the element is a noninteractive visual treatment instead of a button. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Attributes/readonly |
| selected | `boolean` | Indicates whether an element currently holds selection within a multi-option selection group. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-selected) - `true` The element holds selection and represents the user's current choice within the group. - `false` The element does not hold selection and the user can choose it. |
| sort | `'ascending' \| 'descending' \| 'none'` | The current sort value, can be ascending, descending, or none. |
| type | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | Defines the button behavior when associated within a form element. https://mdn.dev/HTML/Element/button#attr-type |
| value | `string` | Defines the value associated with the element's name when submitting the form data. The server receives this value in params when the form submits through this button. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/HTML/Element/input#value) |

### Events

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| sort | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched on activation with `detail: { value, next }`, where `value` is the current sort and `next` follows the cycle `none` → `ascending` → `descending` → `none`. |

## nve-sparkline

A sparkline is a compact, word-sized chart with typographic scale, for data-dense layouts (text, tables, cards, dashboards).

### Example

```html
<nve-sparkline id="default"></nve-sparkline>
<script type="module">
  const sparkline = document.querySelector("nve-sparkline#default");
  sparkline.data = [18, 22, 20, 24, 19, 28, 25, 30];
</script>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/sparkline/define.js';
```

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| data | `number[]` | Numeric values representing a data series. |
| denoteFirst (denote-first) | `boolean` | Denotes the first data point by rendering a symbol at its position. |
| denoteLast (denote-last) | `boolean` | Denotes the last data point by rendering a symbol at its position. |
| denoteMax (denote-max) | `boolean` | Denotes all maximum-value data points by rendering symbols at their positions. |
| denoteMin (denote-min) | `boolean` | Denotes all minimum-value data points by rendering symbols at their positions. |
| interpolation | `'linear' \| 'smooth' \| 'step'` | Controls how the chart connects intermediate values between points in a data series. Defaults to `linear`. - `linear` Connects points with straight line segments. - `smooth` Connects points with smooth bezier curves. - `step` Connects points with horizontal and vertical step segments. |
| intervalLength (interval-length) | `number` | Controls spacing between points in a line, in em (1 = chart height). Defaults to `0.6`. |
| mark | `'line' \| 'area' \| 'gradient' \| 'column' \| 'winloss'` | Controls the visual representation of data points. - `line` Renders data as a connected line to emphasize macro trend. - `area` Renders data as a filled area beneath a line to emphasize magnitude over time. - `gradient` Renders a line with gradient color treatment to communicate value intensity across the series. - `column` Renders data as vertical columns for easy comparison of discrete values. - `winloss` Renders outcomes as binary or ternary bars to highlight wins, losses, and optional ties. |
| max | `number \| undefined` | Upper bound for the y-axis domain. When undefined, derives the bound from data. |
| min | `number \| undefined` | Lower bound for the y-axis domain. When undefined, derives the bound from data. |
| size | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl' \| undefined` | Controls the sparkline size with explicit font-size tokens. Omit to auto-scale with parent font-size (1em). - `xs` Extra small size for minimal elements or highly dense layouts. - `sm` Compact size for dense layouts or secondary elements with less visual prominence. - `md` Standard size that works well in most contexts and provides balanced visibility. - `lg` Larger size for emphasizing important elements or improving touch targets in spacious layouts. - `xl` Extra large size for emphasizing elements or sparse layouts. |
| status | `'scheduled' \| 'queued' \| 'pending' \| 'starting' \| 'running' \| 'restarting' \| 'stopping' \| 'finished' \| 'failed' \| 'unknown' \| 'ignored' \| 'accent' \| 'warning' \| 'success' \| 'danger' \| undefined` | Applies semantic status colors used across Elements status patterns. - `accent` Highlights important actions or draws attention to primary interactive elements. - `warning` Indicates cautionary actions that require careful consideration before proceeding. - `success` Represents positive outcomes, confirmations, or constructive actions. - `danger` Signals destructive or irreversible actions that need extra attention and confirmation. - `scheduled` Task has a scheduled future execution at a specific time. - `queued` Task is waiting in line to begin after other tasks complete. - `pending` Task is awaiting approval, user input, or external conditions before proceeding. - `starting` Task is initializing and preparing to begin active execution. - `running` Task is actively executing and making progress. - `restarting` Task restarts after an interruption or reset. - `stopping` Task is gracefully shutting down and completing cleanup operations. - `finished` Task has completed successfully with the expected outcome. - `failed` Task encountered an error and did not complete as intended. - `unknown` Task status remains unknown or unavailable. - `ignored` Task was intentionally skipped or excluded from execution. |

### CSS Properties

## nve-star-rating

A star rating component lets users rate something using stars, providing a quick visual representation of feedback

### Example

```html
<nve-star-rating>
  <label>rate this input</label>
  <input id="range" type="range" max="5" value="3" min="0" />
  <nve-control-message>message</nve-control-message>
</nve-star-rating>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/star-rating/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | Control input element |
| label | `string` | Label element |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| fitContent (fit-content) | `boolean` | Sets the input to match native default content block |
| fitText (fit-text) | `boolean` | Sets the input to match the width of the active text content of the control value. Only applicable to vertical input box type controls (input, select) |
| i18n |  | Enables internal string values to update for internationalization. |
| layout | `\| 'vertical'
    \| 'vertical-inline'
    \| 'horizontal'
    \| 'horizontal-inline'` | Controls the directional arrangement and spacing behavior of the element's content. - `vertical` Arranges content in a vertical stack with block-level spacing. - `vertical-inline` Arranges content vertically with compact inline spacing for dense layouts. - `horizontal` Arranges content in a horizontal row with block-level spacing. - `horizontal-inline` Arranges content horizontally with compact inline spacing. |
| prominence | `'muted'` | Set the visual prominence of the control |
| status | `'warning' \| 'error' \| 'success' \| 'disabled'` | Set current visual state for control. This overrides any validation states active. |

### Events

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| reset | `CustomEvent` |  |

### Methods

| method | signatures | description |
| ------ | ---------- | ----------- |
| reset | `reset(): unknown` | Resets control value to initial attribute value and clears any active validation rules. |

## nve-steps-item

Represents an individual step within a multi-step workflow, displaying its status and enabling navigation within the parent steps component.

### Example

```html
<nve-steps behavior-select>
  <nve-steps-item status="success">Step 1</nve-steps-item>
  <nve-steps-item status="danger">Step 2</nve-steps-item>
  <nve-steps-item selected>Step 3</nve-steps-item>
  <nve-steps-item status="pending">Step 4</nve-steps-item>
  <nve-steps-item disabled>Disabled</nve-steps-item>
</nve-steps>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/steps/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |

[MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-current) - `page` Marks the current page within a set of navigation links. - `step` Marks the current step within a multi-step process or workflow. |

[MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-disabled) - `true` The element has a disabled state and does not accept interaction. - `false` The element has an enabled state and accepts interaction. |
| expanded | `boolean` | Indicates whether collapsible content is currently visible or hidden from the user. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-expanded) - `true` The associated content expands and becomes visible to the user. - `false` The associated content collapses and hides from the user. |

The HTML attribute accepts only the form ID. Reading the property returns the associated form element or `null`. https://mdn.dev/ElementInternals/form |

[MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-pressed) - `true` The button is in the pressed (on) state and the associated action or setting is active. - `false` The button is in the unpressed (off) state and the associated action or setting is inactive. |

| selected | `boolean` | Indicates whether an element currently holds selection within a multi-option selection group. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-selected) - `true` The element holds selection and represents the user's current choice within the group. - `false` The element does not hold selection and the user can choose it. |

## nve-switch

A switch is a control that enables users to switch between two mutually exclusive options (on or off, checked or unchecked) through a single click or tap.

### Example

```html
<nve-switch>
  <label>label</label>
  <input type="checkbox" />
</nve-switch>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/switch/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | Control input element |
| label | `string` | Label element |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| fitContent (fit-content) | `boolean` | Sets the input to match native default content block |
| fitText (fit-text) | `boolean` | Sets the input to match the width of the active text content of the control value. Only applicable to vertical input box type controls (input, select) |
| i18n |  | Enables internal string values to update for internationalization. |
| layout | `\| 'vertical'
    \| 'vertical-inline'
    \| 'horizontal'
    \| 'horizontal-inline'` | Controls the directional arrangement and spacing behavior of the element's content. - `vertical` Arranges content in a vertical stack with block-level spacing. - `vertical-inline` Arranges content vertically with compact inline spacing for dense layouts. - `horizontal` Arranges content in a horizontal row with block-level spacing. - `horizontal-inline` Arranges content horizontally with compact inline spacing. |
| prominence | `'muted'` | Set the visual prominence of the control |
| status | `'warning' \| 'error' \| 'success' \| 'disabled'` | Set current visual state for control. This overrides any validation states active. |

### Events

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| reset | `CustomEvent` |  |

### Methods

| method | signatures | description |
| ------ | ---------- | ----------- |
| reset | `reset(): unknown` | Resets control value to initial attribute value and clears any active validation rules. |

## nve-tabs-group

Coordinates tabs with matching panel content using Invoker Commands and slot-matched panels.

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/tabs/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | Default slot for a single nve-tabs element. Do not use behavior-select on nve-tabs when using this group. |
| {value} | `string` | Named panel content where the slot name matches a nve-tabs-item value. |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| alignment | `'top' \| 'start' \| 'end'` | Arranges the tab strip relative to slot-matched panels: stacked column (`top`), or sidebar row with tabs at inline-start (`start`) or inline-end (`end`) beside the panel region. |

### Events

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| select | `CustomEvent` | Dispatched when the selected tab value changes after an invoker `--toggle` updates selection |

### Invoker Commands

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| --toggle | `CommandEvent` | Select the matching tab and reveal the panel whose slot matches the invoker value. |

### CSS Properties

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| --padding | `string` | [MDN](https://mdn.dev/CSS/padding) |

## nve-tag

A interactive element that represents a category or group of content. Typically used to filter or organize content for one to many relations.

### Example

```html
<nve-tag>topic-tag</nve-tag>
```

### Import

```javascript
import '@nvidia-elements/core/tag/define.js';
```

### Slots

| name | value | description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| (default) | `string` | Text or other content that identifies the category or group. |
| prefix | `string` | Optional prefix content, such as a status nve-icon. |
| suffix | `string` | Optional suffix content, such as a nve-dot counter. |

### Properties / Attributes

| property (attribute) | value | description |
| -------------------- | ----- | ----------- |
| closable | `boolean` | Indicates whether the user can dismiss or close the element. - `true` The element displays a close control and the user can dismiss it. - `false` The user cannot close the element and must dismiss it programmatically. |
| color | `'red-cardinal' \| 'gray-slate' \| 'gray-denim' \| 'blue-indigo' \| 'blue-cobalt' \| 'blue-sky' \| 'teal-cyan' \| 'green-mint' \| 'teal-seafoam' \| 'green-grass' \| 'yellow-amber' \| 'orange-pumpkin' \| 'red-tomato' \| 'pink-magenta' \| 'purple-plum' \| 'purple-violet' \| 'purple-lavender' \| 'pink-rose' \| 'green-jade' \| 'lime-pear' \| 'yellow-nova' \| 'brand-green'` | Defines a base color from the theme color palette |
| command | `string` | The command to execute on the element. https://mdn.dev/Invoker_Commands_API |
| commandForElement (commandfor) | property: `HTMLElement \| null`; attribute: `string` | The element that receives the command. https://mdn.dev/Invoker_Commands_API |
| current | `'page' \| 'step'` | Indicates the element that represents the user's current location or position within a set. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-current) - `page` Marks the current page within a set of navigation links. - `step` Marks the current step within a multi-step process or workflow. |
| disabled | `boolean` | This Boolean attribute prevents the user from interacting with the element: it cannot receive press or focus events. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-disabled) - `true` The element has a disabled state and does not accept interaction. - `false` The element has an enabled state and accepts interaction. |
| expanded | `boolean` | Indicates whether collapsible content is currently visible or hidden from the user. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-expanded) - `true` The associated content expands and becomes visible to the user. - `false` The associated content collapses and hides from the user. |

The HTML attribute accepts only the form ID. Reading the property returns the associated form element or `null`. https://mdn.dev/ElementInternals/form |

| pressed | `boolean` | Indicates the current state of a toggle button that switches on or off. [MDN](https://mdn.dev/ARIA/Attributes/aria-pressed) - `true` The button is in the pressed (on) state and the associated action or setting is active. - `false` The button is in the unpressed (off) state and the associated action or setting is inactive. |
